title: Nocturnal Pentagram Spread
stated_purpose: Organize a six-card reading into Roots, Past, Trends, Feelings, Outcome, and a final central Inspiration card.
likely_lineage: modern pentagram-shaped cartomancy spread; structurally related to star/pentagram divination layouts rather than a new pentagram lineage
numerology: 5 peripheral positions + 1 center; final card is position 6 and is dealt last
primitive_geometry: upright pentagram outline; five peripheral rectangular card nodes; one central rectangular card node
construction_grammar: place five cards at the pentagram points in numbered order; keep each card upright; deal the sixth Inspiration card to the center only after the five peripheral cards
spatial_arrangement: five role-bearing nodes at the points of an upright pentagram, with one privileged central node
graph_connectivity: literal pentagram edges connect the five peripheral positions; central card overlaps the star field but has no explicit drawn edge; operationally the six positions form one reading network
symmetry: approximate vertical reflection symmetry in the star scaffold; semantic labels and card rectangles introduce small asymmetries
enclosure: no outer boundary; intrinsic central pentagonal field; six card rectangles are local enclosures
axes: vertical Roots-to-center-to-lower field axis; five center-to-point axes implied
paths: numbered dealing sequence 1-5 around the star followed by 6 at center; interpretation can proceed role by role
repeated_motifs: fivefold star; center/periphery role separation; numbered semantic positions
